name: timurmanjosov.com
description: timurmanjosov.com: personal hub of Timur Manjosov. Astro, static output, served by Caddy.

scripts.check:csp: node tools/check-csp.mjs dist && node tools/check-csp.mjs dist-drafts
scripts.check:links: node tools/check-links.mjs dist && node tools/check-links.mjs dist-drafts
scripts.check:seo: node tools/check-seo.mjs dist && node tools/check-seo.mjs dist-drafts
scripts.check:a11y: node tools/check-a11y-static.mjs dist && node tools/check-a11y-static.mjs dist-drafts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run build:drafts && npm run check:csp && npm run check:links && npm run check:html && npm run check:seo && npm run check:http && npm run check:contrast && npm run check:dark-tokens && npm run check:a11y && npm run check:drafts-hidden && npm run check:private && npm run check:build-modes && npm run check:fixtures && npm run check:scheduled && npm run check:blog-i18n && npm run check:publish && npm run check:new-content && npm run check:images && npm run check:github-meta && npm run check:post-surfaces && npm run check:prepush-exit && npm run check:deploy && npm run report:i18n && npm run audit
scripts.check:http: node tools/check-http.mjs dist && node tools/check-http.mjs dist-drafts
scripts.check:articles: python3 -B tests/articles/ecc_toy_curve.py && python3 -B tests/articles/double_spend.py && python3 -B tests/articles/subset_sum.py && node tests/articles/csp_experiments.mjs
scripts.check:articles:system: python3 -B tests/articles/ecc_toy_curve.py && python3 -B tests/articles/double_spend.py && python3 -B tests/articles/subset_sum.py && node tests/articles/csp_experiments.mjs --chromium /usr/bin/chromium
